selection_policy: Algorithm choices may use development cases only. Freeze the algorithm/configuration before opening reserved validation results. A changed algorithm requires a new validation phase; do not relabel development measurements as held-out.
failure_policy: Archive all failures. Native routability at the declared width is required for paired QoR; any width change is a named protocol revision and must apply to both methods.
remaining_scope: real commercial SLR/SLL front-end and legal routing
die, topology, SLL capacity and HBM/PE scaling
claim_limit: These VTR architecture-model cases are useful development evidence; they do not satisfy all G3/G4/G5 requirements or establish commercial deployment performance.
